title: Limes Axis Authorized Search Result Page
description: A bounded, authorized full-text search result page over the tenant-scoped index projection. Current authorization is re-evaluated for every candidate before any representation is produced: records whose access cannot be evaluated are withheld as metadata-only hits, explicit denials are invisible, and totals and facets cover the emitted authorized subset only. Continuation cursors are opaque and bind the presenting principal, the query/filter digest and the index generation.

tenant_id.description: Tenant the search was executed against; always the caller's admitted tenant.

hits.description: Authorized hits for this page in service-determined order. Restricted records appear only as metadata-only hits with a withheld_reason and never carry text.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation token bound to the presenting principal, the query/filter digest and the index generation; null when the authorized result set is exhausted. Cursors expire and are re-authorized on every continuation.

served_under_policy_revision.description: The current search ACL policy revision the page was evaluated under; hits captured under older revisions are withheld until re-indexed.

index_generation.description: Index generation the page was served from; a rebuild invalidates continuation cursors instead of shifting results.

index_stale.description: True when the served page comes from an empty index generation (nothing indexed yet); clients must not fall back to unrestricted source queries.

source_object_id.description: Stable source or ontology identity of the indexed record.

source_locator.description: Opaque source locator; narrowing filter metadata only, never a label.

snippet.description: Exact authorized text span around the first query match; null on metadata-only hits. Stored plain text only, never raw marked-up source.

text_digest.description: Digest binding the served text; null on metadata-only hits.

withheld_reason.description: Present only on metadata-only hits: access_not_evaluable (current authorization could not be evaluated) or not_textually_searchable (tombstoned or textless record).

pageMetadata.description: Counts and facets computed over the authorized emitted subset only; never global counts with rows hidden afterwards.

returned.description: Hits that carried text on this page.

facets.description: Hit counts per resource kind over the emitted authorized subset.
